schemes.name: Telangana ePASS Post-Matric Scholarship
schemes.description: Government of Telangana post-secondary scholarship for eligible students at recognised institutions.
schemes.benefit_summary: Eligible tuition-fee reimbursement and maintenance support; amounts depend on course and applicable rules.

eligibility_conditions.description: Applicant must belong to an eligible welfare category.
Applicant must be a Telangana student.
Applicant must pursue eligible post-secondary education.
Family income must satisfy the official category and rural/urban limit.
Course must not be part-time, online or correspondence.
Admission must not be management quota, sponsored seat or spot admission.

document_requirements: MeeSeva family income certificate (check current validity requirements)
Study/bonafide certificates for previous seven years
CET allotment order for applicable professional courses
Aadhaar documentation is requested by the government portal; do not enter any ID numbers in SchemeSathi
application_steps: Open the official Telangana ePASS Student Services portal.
Choose Post-Matric Fresh or Renewal registration for your academic year.
Check the official prerequisites and complete the government form directly on ePASS; never enter ID numbers in SchemeSathi.
Upload documents requested by ePASS and complete any applicable verification through the official channel.
Save the official acknowledgement/application number privately and check status on ePASS.

schemes.name: Mahatma Jyothiba Phule Overseas Vidya Nidhi (BC/EBC)
schemes.description: Telangana overseas postgraduate study support for eligible BC and EBC graduates; confirm current intake with the department.
schemes.benefit_summary: Overseas education financial assistance subject to official selection and programme rules.

eligibility_conditions.description: Programme is for BC or EBC applicants.
Applicant must be pursuing/planning eligible postgraduate study abroad.
Applicant must have completed a degree.
Published eligibility requires applicant to be younger than 35.
Published family income limit is below ₹5 lakh; verify strict threshold with authority.
Required overseas admission test scores must be available.

document_requirements: Applicable TOEFL/IELTS and GRE/GMAT score reports
application_steps: Check the official BC Development Department programme description and current intake notice.
Confirm that the overseas university, programme and test scores satisfy the current notification.
Prepare official supporting certificates and apply only via the current department-designated portal.
Keep acknowledgement and check the department's official updates.
